text: On February 24, 2021, Toronto and East York Community Council considered and adopted decision number 11 in Item TE23.62, which stated: "Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Strathmore Boulevard, between Dewhurst Boulevard and a point 52 metres west of Donlands Avenue." In order to ensure accessibility for residents requiring accessible parking during this construction, City staff have requested Toronto and East York Community Council adopt the above recommendation.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Strathmore Boulevard, between Dewhurst Boulevard and a point 52 metres west of Donlands Avenue. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Strathmore Boulevard, between Dewhurst Boulevard and a point 52 metres west of Donlands Avenue. 2. Directed that Strathmore Boulevard be returned to pre-construction traffic and parking regulations when the project is complete.
